description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository behaviors, specifically focusing on disabling local paths during clone and fetch operations. It defines test cases, sets up repositories, and verifies expected outcomes related to repository path handling.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Defines a test commit with a specific label.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Sets up protocol tests for repositories with specific URLs or paths.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for negative testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
